annotations.title: Connect a Shopify store with a custom app token

description: Connect a Shopify store to this brand with the Admin API access token of a CUSTOM APP the store owner made (Shopify admin, Settings, Apps and sales channels, Develop apps; it starts with shpat_), for a store that cannot install the Hermoso app. shop is its myshopify address. The token is checked with Shopify before anything is stored, kept encrypted and never shown again; the answer lists any permission the custom app lacks. A store that already runs the Hermoso app connects with connect_shopify_store instead. Free.
